title: Digital technique for fabricating complete dentures with detachable 3D printed cheek plumper prostheses using integrated attachments
html: Cheek plumper prostheses have been used to restore facial fullness in completely edentulous individuals with sunken cheeks. Conventional methods of fabricating detachable cheek plumper prostheses often rely on prefabricated attachments or manual laboratory procedures, which may increase prosthesis bulk and limit reproducibility. This dental technique describes a combined conventional-digital workflow for fabricating complete dentures with detachable 3-dimensionally (3D) printed cheek plumper prostheses using integrated attachment components.
